criteria.short: Weist auf gesundheitlich und strukturell benachteiligte Gruppen hin und erklärt die Gründe
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling weist auf gesundheitlich und strukturell benachteiligte Gruppen hin und erklärt die Gründe hierfür, etwa:
bullets: points out that frontline and essential workers faced higher exposure and risk compared to those able to work from home
explains that people of colour suffered disproportionately due to systemic factors such as poverty, underlying health conditions and racism
highlights that people already facing poverty were hit harder because they lacked financial safety nets
explains that unequal survival rates are directly linked to unequal access to healthcare and economic security
points out that the poem frames these inequalities as a matter of systemic unfairness rather than individual misfortune

criteria.short: Weist auf sozial isolierte und gefährdete Gruppen hin und erklärt die Gründe
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling weist auf sozial isolierte und gefährdete Gruppen hin und erklärt die Gründe hierfür, etwa:
bullets: points out that people living alone experienced isolation and loneliness more severely during lockdown
explains that victims of domestic violence were put at greater risk because lockdown trapped them at home with their abusers
highlights that for some groups, being confined at home meant safety, while for others it meant danger
explains that the poem distinguishes between those who feared being lonely and those who feared their own home
points out that the pandemic intensified pre-existing vulnerabilities rather than creating entirely new ones

criteria.short: Weist auf Gruppen mit eingeschränktem Zugang zu Ressourcen hin und erklärt die Gründe
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling weist auf Gruppen mit eingeschränktem Zugang zu Ressourcen hin und erklärt die Gründe hierfür, etwa:
bullets: points out that homeless people were left especially vulnerable, having no safe place to shelter
explains that children without access to Wi-Fi or a computer were disadvantaged in continuing their education
highlights that a lack of digital resources also meant a lack of access to a 'brighter future'
points out that these material inequalities compounded the health-related risks described elsewhere in the poem

criteria.short: Entwickelt eine schlüssige These, die aufzeigt, wie Register, sprachliche Stilmittel und Struktur zusammenwirken
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling entwickelt eine schlüssige These, die aufzeigt, wie Register, sprachliche Stilmittel und Struktur des Gedichts zusammenwirken, um die intendierte Wirkung auf die Leserschaft zu erzeugen, z. B.:
bullets: claims the poem's informal, direct register combined with its circular structure works to draw the reader into a shared sense of collective responsibility
argues that the poet's use of rhetorical questions and stylistic devices reinforces the poem's persuasive, almost sermon-like appeal
suggests that the interplay of tone shift (from critical to hopeful) and structural framing ('together' as opening and closing word) creates a sense of resolution
points out that the combination of colloquial register and repeated key terms ('we', 'in', 'together') mirrors the poem's argument about shared but unequal experience

criteria.short: Analysiert die Wirkung des Registers
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling analysiert die Wirkung des Registers auf die intendierte Bedeutung des Gedichts, z. B.:
bullets: identifies the informal, conversational register ('is often said', l. 1) that creates immediacy and relatability
notes the shift towards a more formal, hopeful register in the final stanza ('I pray so hard', l. 42)
explains how the direct address through rhetorical questions ('Or are you a "we" on the front-line?', l. 10) implicates the reader personally
points out the use of colloquial phrasing ('bogus', l. 22) that underscores the poem's critical, almost conversational tone
comments on how the shift in register from questioning to declarative in the final lines ('we are in it together', l. 59) reinforces the poem's call to unity
analyses how the informal register invites the reader to reflect on their own position within the different 'we' groups

criteria.short: Analysiert die Wirkung ausgewählter sprachlicher Stilmittel
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling analysiert die Wirkung ausgewählter sprachlicher Stilmittel auf die intendierte Bedeutung des Gedichts, z. B.:
bullets: points out the repetition of 'we', 'in' and 'together' throughout the poem, which structures the argument around the ambiguity of these terms
analyses the anaphora at the beginning of several lines ('Or are you...', 'Or one of the...') that creates a rhythmic, cumulative effect
explains the effect of the antithesis between privileged and underprivileged groups ('Higher survival if you are white' / 'To the dark of skin not fair', ll. 11-15)
comments on the use of rhetorical questions throughout the poem that invite the reader to self-reflect
identifies the metaphor of the mortality tables (l. 8) that lends factual weight to the poem's claims
points out the alliteration and internal rhyme (e.g. 'spun out like a thread', l. 2) that give the poem an almost nursery-rhyme-like quality, contrasting with its serious subject matter
explains how the juxtaposition of short, direct questions and longer reflective statements creates a shifting rhythm that mirrors the poem's shifting perspectives

criteria.short: Analysiert die Wirkung der Struktur
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling analysiert die Wirkung der Struktur des Gedichts auf die intendierte Bedeutung, z. B.:
bullets: points out the tripartite structure that dissects the phrase 'we are in this together' into 'we', 'in' and 'together'
explains how each part builds on rhetorical questions before shifting into a more hopeful, prayer-like final section
analyses the effect of the circular structure, ending with the title phrase ('we are in it together', l. 59), which reframes the initial claim
comments on the use of enjambment throughout the poem that mirrors the poem's unresolved, ongoing questioning
identifies how the change from questioning stanzas to a declarative final stanza structurally supports the poem's move from critique to hope

criteria.short: Bezieht begründet Stellung zu Pichais These
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling bezieht begründet Stellung zu Pichais These, dass eine vielfältige Mischung an Stimmen zu besseren Diskussionen, Entscheidungen und Ergebnissen führt, z. B.:
bullets: agrees that diverse perspectives lead to more well-rounded decision-making processes
acknowledges potential challenges of diverse teams, such as communication barriers or conflicting viewpoints
weighs the benefits of diversity against the difficulty of reaching consensus among differing opinions
takes a nuanced position, arguing that diversity is valuable but must be actively managed to be effective
questions whether Pichai's claim applies equally to all contexts (e.g. business vs. everyday social settings)
concludes with a clear, well-reasoned personal stance on the quote

criteria.short: Bezieht eigene Erfahrung und Erziehung ein
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling bezieht die eigene Erfahrung und Erziehung mit Blick auf Vielfalt und Identität ein, z. B.:
bullets: describes personal experiences of encountering diverse groups or perspectives in their own life
reflects on how their upbringing shaped their understanding of identity and difference
gives a concrete example of a situation in which diverse input led to a better outcome or decision
discusses a personal experience in which a lack of diversity had a negative effect
connects their own background to broader societal patterns of privilege or disadvantage
reflects critically on their own position within these patterns

criteria.short: Bezieht das Gedicht von Bristow ein
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling bezieht das Gedicht von Bristow explizit und differenziert in seine Argumentation ein, z. B.:
bullets: refers to the poem's central idea that the pandemic-era 'we' encompasses vastly different groups and experiences
connects the poem's message about unequal outcomes to the idea that diverse voices need to be heard to address these inequalities
uses the poem's closing vision of a more equal, inclusive 'we' to support or challenge Pichai's optimism about diversity
draws a parallel between the poem's critique of who is included/excluded and Pichai's argument about diverse voices being heard
evaluates whether Pichai's quote would resonate with the groups described as disadvantaged in the poem
uses the poem as evidence to strengthen or complicate their own position on Pichai's statement

criteria.short: Verfasst adressatengerechten Brief mit Bezug zur Kritik im Gedicht
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling verfasst einen adressatengerechten Brief, der die im Gedicht geäußerte Kritik an ungleich verteilten Belastungen während der Pandemie aufgreift, z. B.:
bullets: addresses the letter appropriately to a Congresswoman/Congressman, using a formal register
refers to the poem's criticism that pandemic burdens were unevenly distributed across different groups
highlights specific inequalities raised in the poem (e.g. differences in survival rates, access to digital learning, safety at home)
frames the poem's critique as a call to political action
establishes a clear purpose for writing at the start of the letter
uses the poem's central argument as the basis for the letter's overall stance

criteria.short: Macht drei konkrete Verbesserungsvorschläge
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling macht drei konkrete, nachvollziehbare Verbesserungsvorschläge, z. B.:
bullets: proposes measures to reduce racial and economic health disparities highlighted in the poem
suggests policies to improve access to digital learning devices and internet for disadvantaged children
proposes support systems for people experiencing domestic violence during lockdowns
suggests economic relief measures targeted at low-income or homeless individuals
proposes community-based initiatives to reduce loneliness and isolation
formulates suggestions that are realistic and directly linked to the issues raised in the poem

criteria.short: Bindet eigene Erfahrungen und Unterrichtsinhalte ein (white privilege backpack)
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling bindet eigene Erfahrungen sowie im Unterricht behandelte Inhalte zum Thema (Gender-)Identität ein, insbesondere das Konzept des 'white privilege backpack', z. B.:
bullets: refers to personal experiences related to identity, privilege or disadvantage
explains the concept of the 'white privilege backpack' (invisible, unearned advantages associated with whiteness)
connects the 'white privilege backpack' concept to the inequalities described in the poem
uses the concept to argue why systemic change, not just individual awareness, is needed
reflects on their own position with regard to privilege in light of the concept discussed in class
links the classroom discussion of privilege to the concrete suggestions made in the letter

criteria.short: Erklärt Krafts Sicht auf Queerness und Geschlechtsidentität in Shakespeares Theater
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling erklärt Krafts Sicht auf Queerness und Geschlechtsidentität in Shakespeares Theater, etwa:
bullets: explains that all roles in Shakespeare's time were played by actors perceived as male
points out that Rosalind, played by a male actor, disguises herself as a man within the play
explains that this male character then pretends to be a woman again, creating layers of gender ambiguity
highlights that Shakespeare deliberately creates this elusive, ever-shifting ambivalence around gender
points out that Rosalind and Celia are cousins but also form one of the play's central love pairs
explains that many scenes play with traditional gender roles and expose their absurdity
highlights the subversive humour running through these gender-role reversals
explains that Kraft sees a great deal of queerness already present in the original play
points out that gender swapping and gender play are central to the plot itself

criteria.short: Erklärt Krafts Haltung zur Liebe in Shakespeares Literatur und Theater
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling erklärt Krafts Haltung zur Liebe in Shakespeares Literatur und Theater, etwa:
bullets: explains that love is the main driving force of the plot
points out that love, according to Kraft, is not bound to gender in Shakespeare's play
explains that love is portrayed as a powerful force affecting everyone equally
points out that despite this, the couples are ultimately paired off in a heteronormative way at the end of the original play
explains that in Kraft's own production, this heteronormative sorting will be pushed to an absurd extreme
highlights that Kraft's version will conclude by opening up marriage to everyone
explains that Kraft uses this ending to comment critically on traditional relationship norms

criteria.short: Erklärt Krafts selbst gewählte Mission mit seinem Stück
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling erklärt Krafts selbst gewählte Mission mit seinem Stück, etwa:
bullets: explains that Kraft wants both his parents and his queer friends to be able to enjoy the play equally
points out that he aims to appeal to drag fans as well as people who have never encountered drag before
explains that he wants the play to be enriching for all types of audiences
highlights that he sees this balancing act as challenging but achievable
explains that he believes historical distance helps him grasp the core of a story about being human, rather than about current trends
points out that his goal is for a theatre evening to bring very different people together
explains that he finds this ability of theatre to unite different audiences deeply fulfilling

criteria.short: Kommunikative Textgestaltung
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling richtet seinen Text konsequent und explizit auf die Intention und den Adressatenkreis im Sinne der Aufgabenstellung aus, berücksichtigt den situativen Kontext, beachtet die Textsortenmerkmale des geforderten Zieltextformats, erstellt einen sachgerecht strukturierten Text und gestaltet seinen Text hinreichend ausführlich, aber ohne unnötige Wiederholungen und Umständlichkeiten.

criteria.short: Ausdrucksvermögen/Verfügen über sprachliche Mittel
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling löst sich vom Wortlaut des Ausgangstextes und formuliert eigenständig, ggf. unter Verwendung von Kompensationsstrategien, verwendet funktional einen sachlich wie stilistisch angemessenen und differenzierten allgemeinen, thematischen und Funktionswortschatz und verwendet einen variablen und dem jeweiligen Zieltextformat angemessenen Satzbau.
